status: complete for generated browser React wrappers

implementation.metadata: Standard CEM supplies writable inputs, typed event unions, native-root/target metadata, declared defaults and explicit omission semantics.
implementation.runtime: @lit/react supplies native DOM/attribute rendering. The adapter owns declared-event listener cleanup and projects typed inputs through existing canonical setters; actual styling keys use the shared ownership connection.
implementation.content: Fieldset supplies its native ancestor before connection. OwnedContent exposes the existing mount decision through useSyncExternalStore. React portals own Show/disclosure/Tabs content and native Video sources/tracks.
implementation.refs: Actual custom-element refs, including React callback-ref cleanup.
implementation.registry: Generated wrappers use global definitions. Core class entries and final scoped-registry/platform acceptance remain separately owned by M26.
implementation.build: The root build emits the separate React package after the core package and standard manifest.

verification.build: Strict core and all-wrapper build passed

listenerCleanup.green: The thirteenth case now passes in all three engines, in the workspace and fresh package.

corrections: A nested media.preload assignment no longer overwrites the host accessor default/type.
Inherited appearance defaults match the live elements. Setters accepting omission restore inheritance rather than a fixed visual fallback.
Multiple dispatches of the same event retain all payload shapes, including both Pagination requests.
Ordinary author content retains priority over renderer callbacks.
Removing a React styling prop does not clear a newer input owner.
The captions oracle now explicitly selects the recreated native track. Firefox does not automatically enable that replacement; plain React and native controls were compared.
The Table worker test build now writes its in-memory Bun artifact before serving it.

A retained-node regression exposed custom listeners left by @lit/react after unmount. The adapter now owns declared-event subscriptions and removes them in its React effect cleanup; native attributes remain with @lit/react.

reproduction.note: Final wrapper runtime: thirteen cases per engine on workspace React 19.2.4 and independently installed React 19.3.0, plus nineteen Table/Virtual/Worker cases per engine. The prior fresh 19.2.4 matrix is historical, before listener cleanup.
